title: Bounded ordinary decoding candidates
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a regular unique game over $q$ symbols. Let the table assign to each vertex a function from the Boolean cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{q}$ to $[-1,1]$. For a real parameter $\\varepsilon$ and a vertex $v$, the bounded ordinary decoding candidates are the union of the bounded influential coordinates at $v$ and the bounded neighbor influential coordinates at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
